ti.title: ይትባረክ ከም ኣብርሃም
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ደስ ይበለና’ሞ      ከም ኣብርሃም
በዚ ቅዱስ መርዓ
ፍጹም ቅኑዕ እዩ
ናይ ተኽሊል መርዓና
[[/chorus]]

ይትባረክ ከም ኣብርሃም (2)
እህ ዘለዓለም (4) ይትባረክ ከም ኣብርሃም

ጸጋ መንፈስቅዱስ      ከም ኣብርሃም
ሰለዝተዋህቦም
መርዓውን መርዓትን
ብርሃን ኮይኑ ገጾም

ድንግለይ ባርኽልና ነዞም መርዓውትና
ባርኽልና እህ ባርኽልና
ተረኸቢ >> ኣብ ማእከልና
ንወድኺ >> ለምንልና
ንመርዓና >> ክባርኸልና
ባህ ዘበለ >> ክኾነልና

ti_ro.title: Ytbarek kem abrham
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Ytbarek kem abrham (2)
[[/chorus]]
H zelealem (4) ytbarek kem abrham
Des ybelena’mo kem abrham
Bezi qdus mera
Ftsum qnu yu
Nay tekhlil merana
Tsega menfesqdus kem abrham
Seleztewahbom
Merawn meratn
Brhan koynu getsom
Nay amlakh hyabu kem abrham
Aykonen kem alem
Hagosn selamn
Yhb nzelalem
Dngley barkhlna nezom merawtna
Barkhlna h barkhlna
Terekhebi ab makelna
Nwedkhi lemnlna
Nmerana kbarkhelna
Bah zebele kkhonelna
Ab mnetki h atsnlna
Bkhidanki halwlna
Abti betki ahdrlna
Bfqrkhi tmerlna
Kab frekhi megblna
